notes.title: Update coming soon...
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello, Misfits![/b]
Hope you're all doing well.[/p][p][/p][p]First of all, a big thank you to everyone who added [i]The Misfits[/i] to their wishlist or took the time to try the demo![/p][p][/p][p]We went through a period of relocating our development site and other logistics and ended up falling behind schedule, but now we're back in full swing.[/p][p][/p][p]This past weekend, I showcased an updated version of the game at [b]Retrocon[/b] in São Paulo, and I’ll be uploading this new build to Steam within the next [b]two days[/b] — just as soon as I return to my hometown.[/p][p][/p][p]This updated demo includes [b]around 1.5 hours of new gameplay[/b], depending on the choices you make, and expands on [b]Chapter 1[/b] of the Misfits’ journey.[/p][p][/p][p]I encourage you to play through it more than once, try different decisions, and send me your [b]feedback[/b] using the contact info found on the new version’s main menu.[/p][p][/p][p]Keep an eye on the announcements here on Steam — I’ll let you know as soon as the new version goes live.[/p][p][/p][p]Once again, thank you all so much for your continued support and interest.
[b]Follow our social media pages for more updates![/b][/p]

notes.title: 🔄 Demo Update – Controller Support Improvements! 🎮
notes.content:
Hey, Misfits!

I’ve updated the demo to [b]improve controller support[/b], adjusting both the [b]UI tutorial[/b] and the [b]QTE prompts[/b] to display the correct button icons for Steam Deck and Xbox controllers. Now, playing with a controller should feel much more natural!

However, analog stick movement [b]is not yet supported[/b], and the battler status hover (normally done with the mouse) is [b]still not working with controllers[/b]. Because of this, I’d say the demo currently has about [b]90% controller compatibility[/b].

[b]I’ll keep working[/b] on these improvements, and as always, your[b] feedback is greatly appreciated![/b] Let me know if you encounter any issues or have suggestions.

🎮 Try the [b]updated demo[/b] now and [b]add The Misfits to your Wishlist![/b]

I recommend [b]starting a new game[/b] to ensure the updates are properly applied.
